name: rw_road_rider2
subject: an adult man of about 40 riding a black Dutch city bicycle to the right, sitting upright: short dark green jacket, blue jeans, dark brown boots, a small brown canvas backpack, grey cycling helmet, short dark hair and a short beard; round wheels with thin even spokes and grey tyres, a chain guard, no basket; lit from the upper left: the highlights on the left and top of the helmet, the back and the shoulders, the shade on the right
part_map: the two dark grey rings are the wheels (exactly that size, thin even spokes), the thin grey lines are the frame, handlebar and saddle, the light grey figure is his body (round head, torso upright leaning slightly forward, arm to the handlebar, leg down to the pedal), the white cap is the helmet, the small dark green block on his back is the backpack.
size_sentence: his helmet top is about two and a half times as high as the dog's head and each wheel is about one and a half times as tall as the dog's back. A full-grown adult, drawn a little bigger than the dog's scale because this lane is nearer the viewer.
